cases.name: America Mafalda Thayer
cases.about: She moved to the U.S. from Cuba, and legally changed her name to America when she became a citizen. She and worked at a MyPillow factory and a Dollar Tree store. MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell (said) on her death: “America has been with My Pillow for many years, bringing smiles to so many faces. She was so sweet and kind. We are devastated and are praying for her family.”
cases.caseStatus: NOT GUILTY BY REASON OF INSANITY
cases.narrative: After she told him she wanted to end their relationship, Saborit pulled out a machete, which he often carried with him, dragged her from her car, then stabbed and beheaded her in broad daylight. Her severed head was discovered lying next to her body on the sidewalk. The Shakopee Police Department responded to a report of a headless body dumped from a car near 4th and Spencer. When they arrived on the scene, they found America headless body, along with her head, lying near her car. Witnesses in cars and homes saw the attack, including one who shot a video that appeared to show the suspect pulling Thayer’s body from the car and into the street, then picking up her head by the hair.
